confirmed_blocking.summary: The tracked-dist gate this change makes real (`git diff --exit-code -- dist/`) cannot detect untracked additions, so its documented claim of reporting any source/render divergence is false (ENG-1: the gate does not assert the behaviour it claims).
confirmed_blocking.evidence: Commit 4ed16a9 (T007) records the proof: `git diff --exit-code -- dist/` exited 0 while four `dist/<h>/skill/references/harness/zcode.md` files were untracked additions ('git status reports ?? dist/<h>/skill/references/harness/zcode.md'), yet this change states the gate catches all divergence — quickstart.md:33 'non-zero whenever source and render diverge', spec SC-003 'reports differences whenever the committed distribution and the render diverge', ADR 0005 'any divergence between source and render shows up as a dirty tree', constitution Development Workflow 'proving the committed dist/ matches its source' — and tasks.md T007 (lines 133-134) likewise claims 'the difference check reports the divergence and exits non-zero'. Every future new dist path (a new role file, a new adapter tree) reintroduces silent drift against Constitution III ('dist/ never drifts from its source') and breaks SC-003's acceptance check.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Strengthen the documented gate to cover untracked paths, e.g. `test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist/)"` or `git add -A -- dist/ && git diff --cached --exit-code -- dist/`, and record the corrected command everywhere this change states the gate (quickstart.md step 2, ADR 0005, the constitution's Development Workflow test line) and correct tasks.md T007's expectation text to match.
